# shipd_environment (Resource)

A shipd environment. Destroy archives it for seven-day recovery. Demote the current production environment before promoting another; implicit demotion is rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shipd_project" "app" {
  name = "My application"
  slug = "my-application"
}

resource "shipd_environment" "production" {
  project_id    = shipd_project.app.id
  name          = "Production"
  slug          = "production"
  type          = "production"
  is_production = true

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

output "environment_id" {
  value = shipd_environment.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Environment display name.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID. Changing it replaces the environment.
- `slug` (String) Slug unique within the project.

### Optional

- `is_production` (Boolean) Whether this environment is production. Defaults to false. Only one production environment is allowed per project.
- `type` (String) Free-form classification. Defaults to development; does not control permissions.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable environment ID.
- `version` (Number) API version used for optimistic concurrency checks.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shipd_project.app PROJECT_ID
terraform import shipd_environment.production PROJECT_ID/ENVIRONMENT_ID
```
